balanceOf[_from] -= _value executes an unchecked subtraction (arithmetic underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value executes an unchecked addition (arithmetic overflow risk).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executes an unchecked subtraction.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ executes an unchecked increment that can wrap.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) executes unchecked multiplication.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) executes unchecked multiplication.

edges.reason: transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument, so the caller controls the debited account.
transfer() delegates all state mutation to transferFrom().
msg.sender determines the spender branch and allowance consumption inside transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
Caller-supplied _from is compared against owner, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure().
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale.
condition() reads _maxSale.
condition() reads _saleNum.
condition() returns the boolean gate consumed by ensure().
canSale[_from] short-circuits and bypasses the sale-condition checks.
Comparison with owner immediately returns true, bypassing restrictions.
Comparison with tradeAddress immediately returns true, bypassing restrictions.
transferownership() overwrites tradeAddress, granting an arbitrary bypass address.
Only msg.sender == owner may call transferownership().
approveAndCall() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist bypass.
approveAndCall() performs an unchecked balance assignment computation.
approveAndCall() requires msg.sender == owner.
The constructor computes the initial supply with unchecked multiplication.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor derives owner and the entire initial balance from msg.sender.
The constructor writes totalSupply.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole total supply.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance.
transferFrom() performs an unchecked increment of _onSaleNum.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from].
_value is added to balanceOf[_to].
_from indexes the debited balance slot.
_to indexes the credited balance slot.
_from indexes the incremented sale counter.
transferFrom() uses the _to parameter as the credit target.
transferFrom() uses the _from parameter as the debit target.
transferFrom() uses the _value parameter as the transferred amount.
transfer() forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom().
approve() uses _spender as the allowance key.
approve() stores _value as the allowance amount.
ensure() uses _from for the whitelist comparisons.
ensure() forwards _value to condition().
condition() uses _from to read _onSaleNum.
condition() compares _value with _minSale and _maxSale.
approveAndCall() assigns the computed amount to balanceOf[spender].
addedValue is multiplied by 10**uint256(decimals) without overflow checks.
transferownership() stores addr into tradeAddress.
The constructor stores _name into the name state variable.
The constructor stores _symbol into the symbol state variable.
_supply is multiplied by 10**uint256(decimals) without overflow checks.
The constructor consumes the _supply parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to address parameter of transfer is only forwarded to transferFrom, so it should be merged into the transferFrom function node.
transferFrom._from directly indexes the debited balance and sale counter inside transferFrom.
transferFrom._to directly indexes the credited balance inside transferFrom.
transferFrom._value drives every balance and allowance mutation inside transferFrom.
approve._spender is used only as the allowance key inside approve.
approve._value is stored as the allowance amount inside approve.
ensure._from is only consumed by the whitelist comparisons in ensure.
ensure._value is only forwarded from ensure into condition.
condition._from is only used to read _onSaleNum inside condition.
condition._value is only compared against the sale limits inside condition.
approveAndCall.spender is only used as the key of the unchecked balance assignment.
approveAndCall.addedValue flows straight into the unchecked multiplication stored in balanceOf.
transferownership.addr is only written into tradeAddress by transferownership.
constructor._name is only stored in the name state variable by the constructor.
constructor._symbol is only stored in the symbol state variable by the constructor.
constructor._supply feeds the unchecked totalSupply multiplication performed by the constructor.
